title: Install matching kernel headers before broadcom-wl-dkms
author: paulogeyer
body:
Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/10975

## Summary

The 4.0.3 upgrade swapped `broadcom-wl` for `broadcom-wl-dkms` without headers on stock `linux` (older MacBooks). The module never built, so Wi-Fi died after reboot.

Install matching headers in `fix-bcm43xx.sh`, and repair existing DKMS installs with a migration that covers `linux` / `linux-lts` as well as Omarchy/T2 kernels.

## Test plan

```bash
bash test/shell.d/bcm43xx-headers-test.sh
```
